# Cobrehorno

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [metallic](../lore/worlds/metallic.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `cobrehorno`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Deep rift vent fields (1.8x Earth heat flow, pH 4–6.5 gradients)
- **Diet:** Chemosynthetic symbionts, suspended metal-sulfide particles, vent fluids
- **Active:** Continuous; slow growth and sintering cycles
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Columnar, branching silicate-sulfide composite plates; heat-shock protein-lined sintering chambers; basaltic dorsal heat-sink; vent-facing intake fronds

**Temperament:** Sedentary, defensive, slow-reacting, highly territorial over vents
